tldr: A hot October CPI (core +0.3% vs +0.2% consensus, headline +0.4% vs +0.3%) pushed Fed December hike odds to 100% (from 84%), with Waller and Logan both opening the door to a bigger/faster path -- the 10Y jumped toward 5% and the dollar strengthened.

Biggest portfolio risk today: gold/silver fell 2.7-3.4% on the repricing but the miners fell 4-7% on operating leverage (GDX -5.4%, HL -7.3%) -- COMEX vaults kept draining into backwardation and silver ETF holdings hit a post-March high even as price fell, so this reads as a leveraged flush on rates, not a thesis break.

Nvidia's board confirmed its probe concerns CEO Jensen Huang's admitted affair with a woman US intelligence believes was feeding information to Beijing; Congress summoned him for a Nov 18 closed-door briefing, one day after Nvidia's Nov 17 earnings; NVDA is down more than 10% since Monday.

The index-level pullback (S&P -0.38%) badly understated the damage underneath: NYSE decliners led advancers roughly 2.3-2.5:1 and new-highs-minus-lows worsened sharply on both the S&P and Nasdaq -- mega-cap concentration is masking a rougher broad tape.
China's October trade surplus missed consensus but semiconductor export value surged +137% y/y and the Hang Seng/HS Tech rallied anyway, ahead of SMIC's Nov 12 earnings.
Crypto confirmed it is trading as a rate-sensitive risk asset, not a hedge: BTC fell to a near 3-month low (~$73,874) in lockstep with the hawkish repricing, with ~$1.5B of ETF outflows since Nov 2.

regime.label: Hawkish CPI repricing caps risk-on; mega-cap-led equity resilience and intact physical-metals tightness argue it's a repricing, not a regime change
regime.oneLiner: A hot October CPI print pulled the Fed's December path hawkish and hit precious metals, miners and crypto hard, while equities absorbed it with a deceptively calm headline over a much weaker breadth tape.

topNews.headline: Gold/silver miners crushed far harder than metals after hot CPI repricing (GDX -5.4%, SILJ -5.7 to -6.4%)
topNews.actionable: Levered silver/miner positions took the day's biggest drawdown on operating-leverage amplification of a modest metals pullback; physical tightness (backwardation, vault drain) argues against reading this as a thesis break.

topNews.headline: October CPI runs hot, Fed December hike odds hit 100%
topNews.actionable: Higher real yields are the direct headwind hitting gold/silver miners and crypto hardest, while a stronger case for a higher-for-longer USD complicates HK/SG asset translation.

topNews.headline: Nvidia board probe confirmed: CEO Huang's affair with alleged Chinese intelligence asset; Congress summons him Nov 18
topNews.actionable: A concrete governance/national-security event sitting directly ahead of Nvidia's Nov 17 earnings and SMIC's Nov 12 print -- genuine idiosyncratic risk for anything SMH/XLK-adjacent and a sentiment headwind for the broader China-chip complex.

topNews.headline: Singapore banks' Q3 split (OCBC beats, DBS/UOB miss) but STI still rallies 1.53%
topNews.actionable: OCBC's margin discipline looks relatively better-positioned than DBS/UOB into a higher-for-longer Fed; industrial/logistics REITs are the weak spot versus firmer retail/commercial names.

topNews.headline: SMIC heads into Nov 12 earnings with ~31% revenue growth expected amid Nvidia-linked chip scrutiny
topNews.actionable: A beat-and-raise would be a genuine positive for the HK tech sleeve independent of the Nvidia overhang; any guidance miss would compound an already-cautious China-chip mood.
